They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The sleep schedule looked quieter than usual that evening. Anna and David are preparing a report about the sleep schedule. Best of all, my little brother is in primary school now.
At first, David found it difficult to keep the habit. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. David believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. This program checks your spelling.
People around David often share different ideas about the sleep schedule. David's dream job is to be a driver. David thanked Anna for the honest advice. My shoes got wet in the heavy rain.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Little by little, things began to change. For example, small healthy habits stick best.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. David keeps a small panda at home and feeds it every morning. Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans.
